title: This Program Contains Dialogue
episode: EyeWash Station / The Long Way Up
summary: Pre-program warning sung as a hymn. S&P will not stamp until someone talks. The card never changes.
visualArc: DIALOGUE card → lectern → legal crawl → unstamped PROBABLY FINE → off-mic “Is this on.”
